sections.heading: C - Section Eleven: Vehicle Registration Requirements
sections.markdown:
## C - Section Eleven: Vehicle Registration Requirements

FACT_ID: sec11-F01 | anchor: A01
Vehicles need California registration before lawful use in the state [A01].
Why it matters: registration gates lawful use; the section's founding rule.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec11-F02 | anchor: A01
Registration services and details live online at dmv.ca.gov/vrservices [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec11-F03 | anchor: A01
Buyers hold ten days to transfer ownership into their own names [A01].
Why it matters: the buyer transfer clock is the headline deadline.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec11-F04 | anchor: A01
The ten-day buyer clock runs from the purchase date [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec11-F05 | anchor: A01
Sellers must notify DMV within five days of the sale [A01].
Why it matters: the seller notice clock answers the buyer's.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec11-F06 | anchor: A01
The seller's notice is the Notice of Transfer and Release of Liability [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec11-F07 | anchor: A01
Sellers file the liability notice online at dmv.ca.gov/nrl [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec11-F08 | anchor: A01
New residents and new California job holders hold twenty days to register out-of-state vehicles [A01].
Why it matters: the newcomer clock is the longest deadline here.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec11-F09 | anchor: A01
The twenty-day clock starts at residency or California employment [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec11-F10 | anchor: A01
Out-of-state registration details live online at dmv.ca.gov/outofstatevr [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]

FACT_ID: sec11-F11 | anchor: A01
Registered vehicles must meet California emission controls supporting clean-air standards, and DMV refuses vehicles that do not qualify [A01].
Why it matters: emissions gate registration itself.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0085]
